title: Mini interop contacts and effort bench - Oct 2026
body:
Purpose: quick, human-readable bench of cross-functional contacts + short effort estimates for an unexpected handoff window (3 working days). Use to decide who to call first and which tasks can be deferred or batched.

Context / why this exists:
- Sudden capacity pinch on Dedicated patching cycle next week; need rapid cover and a list of people who can take short lookups, config toggles, and canary rollback help.
- This is intentionally minimal: names, primary response channel, fastest action they can take, ballpark time to resolve.
- Not a replacement for runbooks — this is the one-page strike team list for the first 72 hours.

How to use:
- Filter by "fastest_action" column; call the people marked "<30m" before others.
- If multiple owners are listed, page both and mark the ticket with "wave-1" in Slack for parallel ops.
- Keep edits synchronous in this sheet during the incident; owner should update availability if they switch shifts.

Mini table (columns: role, name, slack, fastest_action, est_time_hrs, escalation):
role,name,slack,fastest_action,est_time_hrs,escalation
SRE,Diego Alvarez,@diego,flip-route-to-fallback,0.5,eng-sre-oncall
Platform Eng,Priya Raman,@priya,scale-dedicated-pool,1,platform-lead
Serving Runtime,Noah Green,@noah,load-model-variant,0.75,runtime-owners
Customer Success,Lena Ortiz,@lena,contact-customer-and-escalate,0.5,cs-manager
Product Ops,Maya Chen,@maya,coordinate-canary-rollout,0.5,prod-vp
Observability,Evan Park,@evan,enable-detailed-traces,0.75,obs-lead
Security,Amira Khalid,@amira,validate-credentials-change,1.5,sec-eng
Solutions Eng,Samir Patel,@samir,assist-tenant-migration,2,solutions-manager

Quick heuristics and decisions:
- If combined est_time_hrs for a route restore path is <= 2.0, prefer manual intervention and keep the customer-facing message short.
- If any single owner shows >2.0, route to a short-lived project team for a deeper fix and set a 24h rollback checkpoint.

One-off micro analysis (very rough):
- Expected triage volume in first 8 hours: 12–18 hits (user tickets + alerts).
- Probable staffing needed: 3 people concurrently for first 8 hours to keep latency within SLOs (mix of SRE + runtime).
- Quick cost estimate for burst (GPU hours): 14h total across two small pools ~ approximate $1,100 (back-of-envelope; use billing console for final).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm EMEA backup owner for Diego (currently ping list, needs a named person).
- Add shortlink to canary rollback docs (confluence) and attach the runbook id.
- Decide whether we treat this as a recurring "patch window" and pre-commit a standby rota.

Notes to self (Maya):
- If you update the table, put a short comment with timestamp.
- If someone is marked as unavailable, add an alternate contact in the same row.

Related links and quick refs:

Quick sign-off area (fill in if you take primary coordination):

- coord_start: 2026-10-12T09:00Z

End of sheet.
